latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release with support for generating 1080p videos from text prompts or images via cloud-based AI.
- Simple setup: automatic anonymous token and session creation, with free credits for new users.
- Supports uploads, text-to-video, video editing, and export to common formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
- Automatic error handling for token expiration, session state, file issues, and rate limits.
- Clear workflows for fast single edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement of videos.
- No local software required — everything runs in the cloud with quick turnaround (1–2 minutes per short video).
